name: qfd_io_emb_tap_m5-m5-COMMIT

Orig owner Claude:qwen-rtl-finish

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_emb_tap #(.LT(9)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src/rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_io_embedding_rom.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: emb_exact
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-PINMISSING -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-LATCH -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -j 4 --top-module tb_qfd_embedding_rom  --Mdir {RUN}/bench/emb_exact rtl/test/qwen_rtl_finish/tb_qfd_embedding_rom.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_io_embedding_rom.sv && {RUN}/bench/emb_exact/Vtb_qfd_embedding_rom
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the c1e4eba84 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src]

bench.cmd:

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_emb_tap  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
